episodes.synopsis: Shido Itsuka is an ordinary high school student living with his little sister in Tengu City, a city that is often disrupted by "spatial quakes". During a spatial quake at the beginning of the school year, he meets a beautiful and mysterious "Spirit".
episodes.title: April 1X

episodes.synopsis: Shido practices making women fall in love with him and has another encounter with the Spirit "Princess".
episodes.title: Another Close Encounter

episodes.synopsis: With the support of Ratatoskr, Shido goes on a date with Tohka as Origami watches from afar.
episodes.title: For the Sky and the Sword

episodes.synopsis: Shido encounters the mysterious "Hermit" one rainy day, and Tohka and Origami fight over Shido at school.
episodes.title: Sullen Rain

episodes.synopsis: Shido goes to Origami's apartment to look for Hermit's puppet, Yoshinon, who was lost during the last fight, and Tohka talks with Reine about her feelings for Shido.
episodes.title: Frozen Ground

episodes.synopsis: Shido and the Spirits decide to visit Tengu City Hot Springs, but they run into some trouble on the way.
episodes.title: Romantic Hot Springs

episodes.synopsis: A young AST joins Origami and the others in the fight against the Spirits. Meanwhile, another transfer student appears at Shido's school.
episodes.title: Visitors

episodes.synopsis: Shido takes Tohka, Kurumi, and Origami out on dates on the same day. Will he be found out?
episodes.title: Triple Capriccio

episodes.synopsis: Shido and the others face off against "Nightmare", and they receive some unexpected help.
episodes.title: Frenzied Nightmare

episodes.synopsis: Shido learns the truth about his and Kotori's powers, and Origami reveals more details about her past.
episodes.title: Flame Spirit (Ifrit)

episodes.synopsis: To get ready for his date with Kotori, Shido goes swimsuit shopping with Tohka and Yoshino. Meanwhile, Origami finds out more about Ifrit.
episodes.title: Countdown

episodes.synopsis: Shido and Kotori enjoy their date at the amusement park until they are interrupted by Origami.
episodes.title: That Which Cannot Be Forgiven
